items.title: XLM parity and threat model
items.blockedReason: XRC source supports XLM/USD and defaults to a received-rate floor of 3 and freshness up to 120 seconds, but live XLM quote/quorum is unknown. The read-only connector refused the backend for lack of a service-discoverability manifest; the direct XRC sample is a paid update and was not called.
items.nextAction: Verify connected-wallet CreateAccount/native Payment support and XRC XLM/USD; verify Stellar root passphrase, provider operator independence and quotas, then select/provision a 2-of-3 set from the documented candidates before any live probes.

items.title: Stable state and XLM launch guard
items.nextAction: Pending-row and attribution insertion is locally tested. Keep it dormant until public confirm APIs and the atomic credit flow are implemented; keep XLM Frozen.

items.title: Verified deposits and borrowing
items.blockedReason: Real testnet providers are configured but unbuilt (compute held). Only two free providers are independent and reliable; the third (Tatum keyless) is throttled, so live confirmation depends on both SDF and Ankr.
items.nextAction: When XLM gets a fresh compute slot, build and run the focused tests; CTO chooses the third-provider option (keep throttled Tatum, paid keyed provider, or Rumi-run Horizon); then a live testnet confirm.

items.title: Claims, exits, and liquidation handling
items.blockedReason: No supported XLM claim, withdrawal, close, or liquidation payout lifecycle exists. Unsupported routes fail closed in source, but the current guards have not been Cargo-tested; claim/intent state is dormant and Frozen config keeps XLM unreachable.
items.nextAction: Compile/test the claim recorder's fee, destination, and key/network guards when the shared heavy slot is available; then integrate and validate XLM claim settlement/reconciliation, keeping WP4 blocked until payout lifecycle evidence exists.

items.title: User flows, Candid, and monitoring
items.nextAction: Interface and frontend declarations are synced. Next, implement supported user flows with explicit pending/unresolved states; keep them unavailable until route and integration safety is resolved. The explorer formatter test still needs to run.

items.title: Tests, independent review, and testnet

Keep the XRP post-sign race separate, not an XLM gate.
